title: The tajweed map: Al-Fatihah line by line: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Tajweed mastery and Al-Kahf consolidation
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 1 (Pupil PDF worksheet: The tajweed map rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 1. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Juz' Tabarak with the map
points: Name one rule from each family

head: Not this
This
rows: ٱلضَّآلِّينَ with 2 counts and ض like د
6 counts (madd lazim); ض from the side of the tongue

keywords.def: giving each letter its right and its rules

questions.q: Map Al-Fatihah 1:4 «مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ» to the six families.
questions.a: مَٰلِكِ: small alif madd 2; يَوْمِ: و sakin after fathah (leen when stopping only); ٱلدِّينِ: sun letter د, madd 'arid at the stop.

questions.q: Map Al-Mulk 67:1 to 2 to the six families (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites Juz' Tabarak placement surahs to the teacher.
questions.a: e.g. شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ ikhfa; ٱلْمُلْكُ moon letter; عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ idgham if joined; ٱلْعَزِيزُ moon letter; ۚ ja'iz stop; قَدِيرٌ 'arid at a stop.

questions.q: Extend: name the family you find hardest and one practice for it.
questions.a: Personal target with a practice plan.

questions.q: Stretch: explain the difference between madd lazim and madd 'arid.
questions.a: Lazim: permanent sukoon in the word, always 6; 'arid: sukoon only from stopping, 2, 4 or 6.

questions.q: The madd in «وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ» before the shaddah is ...
questions.a: A) Madd lazim: 6. Alif followed by a letter with shaddah (a permanent sukoon) in the word: madd lazim kalimi, 6.

questions.q: How many families on the map?
Think again: You recite Al-Fatihah at least 17 times a day. If you audited it today, would it pass every rule?
questions.a: Many find small slips (madd, heavy letters, ض). The most recited surah deserves the most care.
